scenarios.name: Native service invocation proves exact finalization RPC exists
Publish and every permanent pre-candidate failure atomically produce exact full tuples
Closed branch inputs reject malformed metadata and stale fences without side effects
Reserved, foreign and persisted candidate drift cannot manufacture prepared publication evidence
Full pinned manifest and access revocation guards apply to both terminal actions
Every terminal DML error or suppressed update rolls back all previous writes
Expiry during every terminal write rolls back success and permanent failure
Lease expiry after table, job, candidate and asset-upgrade lock waits fails closed
Deletion committed first is observed after waiting on absent-tombstone barrier
Finalizer committed first blocks deletion insertion until whole terminal tuple is visible
Membership revoke races serialize in both orders
Reverse legacy project-lock then tombstone write safely deadlocks without partial finalization
Concurrent duplicate publishes produce one complete commit and one fenced loser
READ COMMITTED is mandatory and lock wait is bounded inside function
Function ACL, fixed execution configuration and restrictive Storage policies remain private
